children: Bank of Thailand sees a continued need for accommodative monetary policy as the economic recovery remains uneven, the August meeting minutes showed.
The Monetary Policy Committee unanimously kept the one-day repurchase rate at 1% for a third consecutive meeting, citing weak and uneven growth.

However, policymakers cautioned that further easing outside a crisis could have limited benefits relative to potential side effects. “Although policy space remained, further monetary policy easing in a non-crisis environment might yield limited additional benefits relative to its potential side effects,” the minutes said.
With the policy rate already low by historical standards, the committee stressed the need to preserve room to respond to unexpected shocks.
It also flagged risks from the Middle East conflict, trade protectionism and inflation.

title: Bank of Thailand Keeps Door Open to Further Rate Cuts
